title: Elephant wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='45,22 55,22 50,5' fill='#ff4f9a'/>
  <polygon points='47.5,13 52.5,13 50,5' fill='#ffd93d'/>
  <polygon points='45,22 55,22 53,17 47,17' fill='#6ee7ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='5' r='3' fill='#ffd93d'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='5' r='1.5' fill='#ff4f9a'/>

  <!-- Elephant body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='26' ry='24' fill='#8fb3d9'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='20' ry='18' fill='#a9c6e8'/>

  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='82' width='10' height='12' rx='3' fill='#7a9fc7'/>
  <rect x='60' y='82' width='10' height='12' rx='3' fill='#7a9fc7'/>
  <rect x='30' y='92' width='10' height='4' rx='2' fill='#b8d4f0'/>
  <rect x='60' y='92' width='10' height='4' rx='2' fill='#b8d4f0'/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#8fb3d9'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='17' ry='15' fill='#a9c6e8'/>

  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='48' rx='10' ry='14' fill='#7a9fc7'/>
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='48' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#f4a7c3'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='48' rx='10' ry='14' fill='#7a9fc7'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='48' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#f4a7c3'/>

  <!-- Trunk -->
  <path d='M50,58 Q48,70 44,76 Q40,82 44,84 Q48,84 50,78 Q52,72 54,64' fill='#8fb3d9' stroke='#a9c6e8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M46,78 Q48,82 42,83' fill='none' stroke='#a9c6e8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='47' r='3.5' fill='#2a4a6b'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='46' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='47' r='3.5' fill='#2a4a6b'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='46' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='55' r='3' fill='#f4a7c3' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='55' r='3' fill='#f4a7c3' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M44,57 Q50,62 56,57' fill='none' stroke='#5a7fa8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M76,72 Q86,70 88,78 Q89,83 84,84' fill='none' stroke='#7a9fc7' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='84' r='2.5' fill='#f4a7c3'/>
</svg>
